name: Plastic water bottle
instructions: Empty, rinse, and crush before placing in the blue recycling bin.

name: Newspaper
instructions: Keep dry and bundle with other paper waste in the green bin.

name: Old smartphone
instructions: Drop off at a certified e-waste collection point; never bin electronics.

name: Glass jar
instructions: Rinse and remove lid, place in the glass recycling bin.

name: Aluminium can
instructions: Rinse and crush, place in the metal recycling bin.

name: Vegetable peels
instructions: Add to the compost bin or campus composting unit.

name: Used batteries
instructions: Never bin regular waste; drop off at the hazardous waste collection point.

name: Cardboard box
instructions: Flatten and keep dry before placing in the green bin.

name: Plastic bag
instructions: Most curbside programs reject these — reuse or return to store drop-off points.

name: Paint can (empty, dried)
instructions: Dried paint cans go to hazardous waste collection, not regular recycling.
